# Section 1: Overview

# Purpose

To enable automatic mapping of matching colors and sizes in the table dependency.

Business Requirement
Currently, users are required to manually map the color and size dependency between the apparel and the material. This process is time-consuming and prone to errors.
We require a system enhancement where the color and size mapping is automated based on matching values.
If both the apparel and the material have the same color, the system should automatically map that color in the table dependency. Similarly, if the sizes match, they should also be auto-mapped accordingly.

# Assumptions
• This change will not impact existing functionalities.

# Section 2:
Functional Requirements

The system should automatically map color and size dependencies between Apparel and Material based on matching values. If the color and/or size in both match, the system should auto-populate the dependency table accordingly.
This auto-mapping should trigger during creation or update, while still allowing users to manually edit or override if needed.
Color Dependency



 The system should automatically map colors in the table dependency when the same color (e.g., White 001A) exists in both the Article (Apparel) and the Material. The matching color should be auto-populated in the dependency table without manual intervention.
 This auto-mapping functionality should be applicable to all material types (not limited to fabric). Additionally, the system should allow users to manually modify or override the auto-mapped values as per business requirements.
Size Dependency
• The system should automatically map sizes in the table dependency when the same size (e.g., 62 (62)) exists in both the Article (Apparel) and the Material. The matching size should be auto-populated without manual intervention.
• This auto-mapping should be applicable to all material types, and users should be able to manually modify or override the mapped sizes as per requirement.
